trainer/30835.htm.text: Lich King Icarus: I've never seen you before, have I? Ah, yours is a face full of vitality and life. I like it very much. Perhaps I might sample your inner self as well... My, my, what a shocked expression you wear! Ha ha! I am Icarus, the sole survivor of the 13 Lich Kings who once shook the Elmor…

trainer/30835-1.htm.text: Lich King Icarus: What do you think I am doing here? Fool! I teach the skills I learned as a Necromancer. No, don't look so afraid. Liches rarely eat Human flesh...although to be honest it IS something of a delicacy... Actually, we undead have no need to eat at all. No, we try to be fairly...civili…

trainer/30835-2.htm.text: Lich King Icarus: Hardin? I've known him for years. But even after all that time, I don't suppose I can say I really know him well. Often he wanders off suddenly, leaving this Academy virtually empty. Where he goes and what he does, I have no idea. No doubt something that would shock and amaze you.…

trainer/30835-noteach.htm.text: Lich King Icarus: Bwa ha ha! You must be insane, just like that old Hardin! What do you think I can teach you? Although I'm dead now, in my former life I acquired Human mystical skills! SO i can only teach Human mystics! Why don't you go look for a teacher who would be more suitable for you?

Q00343_UnderTheShadowOfTheIvoryTower/308.text: Lich King Icarus: What a miserable state I'm in, neither dead or alive, just here. What's the point? I'm an undead... No hope for me. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
